item.title: Beppu Tower — Guide
item.description: Beppu Tower, standing near the bayfront in central Beppu, is one of Japan’s classic ‘Tower Six’ observation towers, built in the 1950s during the postwar era of tower-building and designed by the same architect behind Tokyo Tower and others. A registered tangible cultural property, it has a charming retro, mid-century character. From its observation deck, visitors get a sweeping panorama over the city of Beppu spread along its bay, with the columns of white steam rising from the onsen districts across the townscape, the sweep of Beppu Bay, and the surrounding mountains including Mount Tsurumi behind.
